lastCheckpoint.note: Run contaminated the same way as the three before it: the seal check was recorded, FAILED for a real defect (the refusal path unlinked the symlink it was protecting), was fixed, and then re-recorded PASS. Naming it as an expansion witness is therefore refused, correctly — every recorded status for a witness must be PASS. The fix itself is sound: six consecutive green runs of memory-bootstrap-sealed, plus ai-policy-lint and ai-doctor PASS. Closing BLOCKED rather than renaming the check to dodge the rule. Separate finding for a later run: the rule penalises the ordinary fail-fix-verify loop, which deserves a deliberate decision, not an edit made to unblock the run it is judging.
